🍎 The Moment of Choice — Witnessing the Temptation in Eden
📖 Scripture Reference: Genesis 3:1–6

When I read the Bible, it feels like I am there witnessing the moment.
I stand quietly in Eden, surrounded by beauty untouched—yet something feels fragile. The garden is peaceful, but the air is tense. I watch Eve listen, hesitate, and reach. 🌿

It reminds me how temptation rarely arrives loudly. It whispers. It reasons. It invites reflection without obedience. And I wonder—how often do I stand at my own crossroads, surrounded by God’s goodness, yet drawn toward doubt?
What would it look like to choose trust when everything feels harmless?
💭 Share what this moment stirs in you
What details in this moment make the temptation feel subtle rather than dramatic?
Where in your own life do choices feel quiet—but weighty?
How does witnessing this scene shape your understanding of trust and obedience?
What helps you pause before reaching for something God has warned against?
